title: Pokke Farm file
description: Pokke Farm's gathering points, read from the EBOOT: each Mining Point, Insect Thicket, Mushroom Tree and Bee Hive, with what it gives. The farm restocks after every quest, drawing each point's items that many times.

points.description: In the EBOOT's order: the mining points, insect thickets, mushroom trees, then bee hives, each spot's from its first level up

point.$comment: The farm upgrade's name, as the game names it ("Mining Point +2", "Production Bee Hive"), is in data/strings under 'farm', keyed by the point's index in this list.

gathers.description: How many items the restock draws from it, at least

most_gathers.description: How many items the restock draws from it, at most
